description: This file provides functions for managing authentication tokens (access and refresh tokens) stored in localStorage within a React-based web application. It includes methods for retrieving, storing, normalizing, and clearing tokens, along with handling legacy keys for backwards compatibility.

methods.name: normalizeStoredToken
methods.description: Normalizes stored token value by converting to string, trimming whitespace, and treating empty or 'null'/'undefined' strings as null.

methods.name: stripBearerPrefix
methods.description: Removes 'Bearer ' prefix from tokens, used to store raw tokens only.
